name: Spring of the First Dewdrop
description: A limpid drop of dew floating amidst the waters of Morte Region. It is different from other pure water bodies, as though it is a conglomeration of even more pure and primordial Elemental Energy.
fullDescription: A limpid drop of dew floating amidst the waters of Morte Region. It is different from other pure water bodies, as though it is a conglomeration of even more pure and primordial Elemental Energy.\nThe Natural Philosophers of ancient Fontaine never recorded such a creation, until engineers from the Fontaine Research Institute began to conduct some scattered research over 400 years ago. Some scholars believe that this pure Ichor was the final legacy Egeria bequeathed to Fontaine — but even today, this theory has no reliable evidence to support it.
sources: Recommendation: Found underwater in Morte Region
